en.description:
Roll the silver ball through 15 mazes using nothing but the tilt of your wrist. One wrong move into a wall and it's over — how far can you get?

Iron Maze is built for Apple Watch and controlled entirely by motion. Pick your challenge on iPhone, then play on your wrist.

GAME MODES
• Competitive — 3 lives, deadly walls. The classic test of nerve. (Free)
• Fun — unlimited lives, walls just bounce. Pure, relaxed play. (Pro)
• Speed — a timed race to your chosen level. Beat the clock. (Pro)
• Compete — records your run so you can replay it on iPhone and share it with friends. (Pro)

POWER-UPS
• Extra life
• Slow-down
• Instant level skip

FEATURES
• 15 levels with a smooth difficulty curve
• Adjustable ball sensitivity from your iPhone
• Tap-to-start between levels — no cheap deaths
• Designed for every Apple Watch size

Free to download and play Competitive mode. Unlock Fun, Speed, and Compete modes forever with a single Iron Maze Pro purchase.
en.releaseNotes: Now confirms Iron Maze is installed on your Apple Watch — with setup steps if it isn't.
en.subtitle: Labyrinth on your watch
